judge.rationale: The candidate satisfies every acceptance criterion from the issue: it removes the `instanceof Error` gate on `onError`, wraps non-`Error` rejections (string, plain object, `undefined`) in an `Error` with `cause` set to the original value, preserves the original rejection at the caller boundary, and keeps existing `Error` tests untouched. It also properly updates `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and the line-number references in sibling spec files. The main differences from the reference are that the candidate uses `String(error)` directly for the wrapper message instead of attempting `JSON.stringify` first via `describeRejection`, and it adds a separate `onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts` file alongside the unit test in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
